content.text: My symmetric `Math.abs` check is wrong: a future timestamp 6s ahead is inside the 300s window, and it needs its own code anyway. Splitting into a forward-skew check (5s, `timestamp_in_future`) and a backward staleness check (300s, `signature_expired`).
